title: 17th Century Color Book
content: In 1692, Dutch artist A. Boogert made a one-of-a-kind teaching manual with over 800 pages of color swatches, meticulously cataloguing the many possible colors that he could mix from watercolors.More atThis is CollossalThanks to Roberto Quintano, Dustin Wilson, Tim Fehr, and Steve Gilzow for telling me about it.
